series_short_description: The Stardust Engine's cosmic expedition aboard the U.S.S. Aethelgard to the purple-ocean sanctuary moon Caelum-IV.
series_description: The cosmic visual storybook and planetary expedition chronicles of The Stardust Engine aboard the U.S.S. Aethelgard. Beginning inside the subterranean launch cavern beneath 'The Fortress' on Industrial Park Road in Blacksburg, Virginia (Movements I–III), Ryan, Cassidy, and Holly O'Connell—alongside twin pilots Tyler and Evan Wright—leave the fluorescent Cage of Earth behind, cross 1,200 light-years at FTL Harmonic Continuum speed, and step onto Caelum-IV (Movement IV, Stardate 49601): a 48-hour tidally locked, 0.88G purple-ocean moon orbiting the ringed super-Jovian Vespera (Kepler-442c) whose living biosphere pulses at 120.0 BPM.

Aethelgard rests on hydraulic launch cradles over a misting flame trench as camouflaged quarry blast doors part overhead toward the starry Virginia night sky. parts.image_alt: Photorealistic widescreen view inside the forward cockpit of the U.S.S. Aethelgard during orbital ascent. Identical twin cousins Tyler and Evan Wright sit in the Port (Pilot) and Starboard (Copilot) leather flight seats wearing 5-point harnesses with their hands on dual flight sticks. Centered between them on the diamond-plate deck, mid-20s Ryan O'Connell sits in his manual wheelchair anchored by four heavy-duty floor ratchet tie-down straps and a 6-point aerospace chest harness over his maroon CPI shirt.
